bounded_conclusion_ja: 全36環境には固定した非線形モデル内で離れた未知属の写真花色組成を予測する小さい追加情報が残ったが、線形全環境モデルへの全体優位と厳格画質での頑健性は確認できず、地域共通の非線形生態応答を特定したとはいえない。

scientific_review.scope: Actual results and ecology report independently reviewed; no new model selection or outcome-dependent tuning.

limitations: Retrospective source-exposed fixed model-form test, not preregistration or independent biological replication.
Four longitude sectors are artificial domains, not independent evolutionary replicates.
GEO is a specified coordinate baseline, not comprehensive spatial adjustment.
Bootstrap conditions on existing fits and folds and does not refit learners.
Photographic colour proportions do not identify pigments, selection, pollination, herbivory, fitness or genotypes.
Missing classification, measurement error and unobserved real populations remain.
Predictive failure cannot establish universal absence of environmental responses.
Primary increment coexists with a worse nonlinear geography baseline; direct full-model improvement is uncertain.
Strict-photo sensitivity is inconclusive and changes the available species/photos.
Fixed tree means do not generally extrapolate smooth responses beyond learned support.
Regional and component comparisons are descriptive; differing interval signs do not establish between-group differences.
